chunks.section: Employee Roles and Access Policy — Baraka General Store
chunks.text:
# Employee Roles and Access Policy — Baraka General Store

**Last updated:** 2026-07-01
**Applies to:** all staff and the Duka Akili assistant

chunks.title: Employee Roles and Access Policy — Baraka General Store
chunks.text:
## 1. Roles

Baraka General Store has three levels of staff:

- **Owner** — Faith Wanjiru. Full authority over the business: supplier agreements, margins, pricing changes, tax filings, hiring, and firing.
- **Shop Manager** — Peter Otieno. Runs day-to-day operations: authorizes manager override discounts, handles supplier delivery disputes escalated from staff, approves the staff shift schedule.
- **Shop Attendant** — Grace Achieng and Brian Mwangi. Serves customers at the counter: applies the standard discount tiers, receives deliveries, and escalates anything outside their authority to the shop manager.

chunks.title: Employee Roles and Access Policy — Baraka General Store
chunks.text:
## 2. Discount Authorization Limits

2.1. Any staff member may apply the standard tier discount from the Pricing and Discount Policy — walk-in, regular, wholesale, or partner — without approval, since these are fixed rates that do not require judgment.

2.2. Only the Shop Manager or the Owner may authorize the manager override of up to 5% described in the Pricing and Discount Policy, section 4. A shop attendant must never apply this override on their own signature, even for a customer they know well or a bag that is visibly close to expiry.

2.3. No one, including the Owner, may authorize a discount larger than the manager override cap without a written exception signed and dated, kept with the till log.

chunks.title: Employee Roles and Access Policy — Baraka General Store
chunks.section: 3. What Each Role May Ask Duka Akili
chunks.text:
## 3. What Each Role May Ask Duka Akili

3.1. Shop attendants may ask about pricing tiers, return and refund windows, and general shop policy. They should not ask Duka Akili to disclose supplier payment terms, invoice values, or profit margins — those questions should go to the Shop Manager or Owner directly.

3.2. The Shop Manager may additionally ask about supplier credit terms, delivery dispute history, and discount override authorization.

3.3. Only the Owner should ask about tax filings, overall revenue, or the terms for renegotiating or terminating a supplier agreement.

chunks.title: Employee Roles and Access Policy — Baraka General Store
chunks.text:
## 4. Escalation

4.1. A shop attendant who is asked for a discount or exception beyond what section 2.1 permits must refer the customer to the Shop Manager, not decide it themselves and mention it later.

4.2. A delivery dispute that the Shop Manager cannot resolve within 3 days, per the Staff Handbook section 6, goes to the Owner.

chunks.title: Employee Roles and Access Policy — Baraka General Store
chunks.text:
## 5. Audit

5.1. Any discount override the Shop Manager authorizes should be recorded in the till log with the manager's initials, the customer, and the reason, so the Owner can review overrides during the monthly reconciliation.

---
*This policy states who is authorized to approve what. It does not, on its own, technically prevent a question from being answered by role — that access control is tracked as a roadmap item. Until then, staff are expected to follow the limits in this document themselves.*

chunks.title: KRA Turnover Tax (TOT) Guide for Small Retailers
chunks.section: KRA Turnover Tax (TOT) Guide for Small Retailers
chunks.text:
# KRA Turnover Tax (TOT) Guide for Small Retailers

**Shop:** Baraka General Store, Kawangware, Nairobi
**Source basis:** Kenya Revenue Authority turnover tax guidance for small businesses.
**Applies to:** businesses with annual gross sales between KES 500,000 and KES 25,000,000, that are not VAT registered.

chunks.title: KRA Turnover Tax (TOT) Guide for Small Retailers
chunks.text:
## 1. What Turnover Tax is

Turnover Tax (TOT) is charged on gross sales, not profit, at a rate of **3%** of monthly gross turnover. It replaces the need to calculate deductible expenses for tax purposes.

chunks.title: KRA Turnover Tax (TOT) Guide for Small Retailers
chunks.text:
## 2. Filing deadline

2.1. TOT is filed and paid **monthly**, by the **20th day of the following month**. For example, July's turnover tax is due by 20 August.

2.2. Filing is done through the iTax portal. A KRA PIN is required to register.

chunks.title: KRA Turnover Tax (TOT) Guide for Small Retailers
chunks.text:
## 3. Record keeping

3.1. Retailers must keep a daily record of gross sales, even informally in a ledger book, to support the monthly TOT return.

3.2. Records should be kept for a minimum of **5 years** in case of an audit.

chunks.title: KRA Turnover Tax (TOT) Guide for Small Retailers
chunks.text:
## 4. Penalties

4.1. Late filing attracts a penalty of the higher of 5% of the tax due or KES 2,000.

4.2. Late payment attracts a further 1% interest per month on the unpaid amount.

chunks.title: KRA Turnover Tax (TOT) Guide for Small Retailers
chunks.text:
## 5. Exemptions

5.1. Rental income, management or professional fees, and the first KES 500,000 of annual turnover are not subject to TOT.

5.2. A business that registers for VAT voluntarily is no longer eligible for TOT and must switch tax regimes.

---
*This is a general guide for small retail businesses and does not replace direct KRA guidance or a licensed tax advisor for cases with unusual circumstances.*

chunks.title: Pricing and Customer Discount Policy
chunks.text:
# Pricing and Customer Discount Policy

**Shop:** Baraka General Store, Kawangware, Nairobi
**Last updated:** 2026-01-15
**Applies to:** all sales, wholesale and retail

chunks.title: Pricing and Customer Discount Policy
chunks.text:
## 1. Customer tiers

| Tier | Qualifying condition | Discount on total bill |
|------|----------------------|-------------------------|
| Walk-in | No account, pays on the spot | 0% |
| Regular | Registered customer, 3+ purchases in the last 30 days | 3% |
| Wholesale | Buys 20kg or more of a single item in one visit | 7% |
| Partner | Written agreement with the shop (churches, schools, SACCOs) | 10% |

chunks.title: Pricing and Customer Discount Policy
chunks.text:
## 2. Stacking rules

2.1. Discounts do **not** stack. A customer qualifying for more than one tier receives only the highest single discount that applies.

2.2. Wholesale and Partner discounts apply to the qualifying item only, not the whole basket, unless the whole basket meets the same condition.

chunks.title: Pricing and Customer Discount Policy
chunks.text:
## 3. Rounding

3.1. Discounted totals are rounded down to the nearest shilling in the customer's favor.

chunks.title: Pricing and Customer Discount Policy
chunks.text:
## 4. Manager override

4.1. The shop manager may authorize an additional discount of up to 5% on top of the applicable tier discount for bulk clearance of near-expiry stock. This requires a manager's signature in the sales book and cannot be applied by staff without it. See the Employee Roles and Access Policy for who holds shop manager authority and what a shop attendant must escalate instead of approving themselves.

chunks.title: Pricing and Customer Discount Policy
chunks.text:
## 5. Promotional pricing

5.1. Any promotional price posted in the shop overrides the tier discount for that specific item during the promotion period, and promotional prices do not stack with tier discounts.

chunks.title: Staff Handbook — Baraka General Store
chunks.text:
# Staff Handbook — Baraka General Store

**Shop:** Baraka General Store, Kawangware, Nairobi
**Last updated:** 2025-08-10
**Applies to:** all staff

chunks.title: Staff Handbook — Baraka General Store
chunks.text:
## 1. Welcome and Shop Hours

Baraka General Store is open Monday to Saturday, 6:30am to 9:00pm, and Sunday, 8:00am to 7:00pm. Staff on the opening shift must arrive 15 minutes before opening to set up the counter and check the previous night's till reconciliation.

chunks.title: Staff Handbook — Baraka General Store
chunks.text:
## 2. Customer Service Standards

- Greet every customer within a few seconds of them reaching the counter.
- If you do not know the answer to a pricing or policy question, do not guess. Check with the shop manager or use Duka Akili to look it up before answering the customer.
- Regular and wholesale customers should be recognized and offered their correct discount tier without being asked to prove it every visit, once registered.

chunks.title: Staff Handbook — Baraka General Store
chunks.text:
## 3. Cash Handling and Till Procedure

3.1. The till float at the start of each shift is KES 2,000. Count it with the outgoing staff member before they leave.

3.2. Any single cash sale above KES 5,000 should be confirmed against the receipt book before the customer leaves.

3.3. M-Pesa till number for the shop is separate from the owner's personal number. Never ask a customer to send payment to a personal number.

3.4. At the end of each shift, count the till, record the total in the till log, and leave a signed handover note for the next shift.

chunks.title: Staff Handbook — Baraka General Store
chunks.text:
## 4. Handling Supplier Deliveries and Returns

### 4.1 Receiving a delivery

- Check the delivery note against what was actually ordered before signing anything.
- Count bags and inspect for torn or wet packaging while the driver is still present.

### 4.2 Damaged or torn stock

If any bags arrive damaged or torn, report it to the shop manager within **7 days** of delivery so it can be raised with the supplier for credit or replacement. Take a photo if possible, but a written note in the delivery log is acceptable if a phone is not available.

### 4.3 Paying delivery drivers

Some suppliers allow cash payment directly to the delivery driver against the invoice, especially for small or urgent top-up orders. Always ask for a signed receipt from the driver if paying cash on delivery. Check the specific supplier's contract on file first, since not every supplier accepts cash at the door.

### 4.4 Expired stock

Never accept stock that is already past its printed expiry date. Refuse the delivery at the door and note it in the delivery log.

chunks.title: Staff Handbook — Baraka General Store
chunks.text:
## 5. Health and Safety

5.1. Keep the aisle in front of the cold storage unit clear at all times; it is also the fire exit route.

5.2. Report any spill immediately and mop it before continuing service, even if it means a short queue at the till.

5.3. The first aid kit is kept under the counter, next to the till log. Restock it from the owner if anything is used.

chunks.title: Staff Handbook — Baraka General Store
chunks.text:
## 6. Who to Contact

For any delivery dispute, first contact the shop manager. If unresolved within 3 days, escalate to the owner directly. For questions about your own pay, shift schedule, or role, speak to the owner.

---
*This handbook is reviewed annually. Staff should also check the specific supplier contract on file for deliveries and returns, as individual supplier terms may differ from the general guidance in section 4, and the employee_roles_and_access_policy document for what you are authorized to approve without escalation.*

chunks.title: Supplier Agreement: Coastal Beverages Distributors
chunks.text:
# Supplier Agreement: Coastal Beverages Distributors

**Parties:** Coastal Beverages Distributors ("Supplier") and Baraka General Store, Kawangware ("Retailer")
**Effective date:** 2026-05-20
**Products covered:** Soda (sodas and soft drinks), maji (bottled water), juice cartons

chunks.title: Supplier Agreement: Coastal Beverages Distributors
chunks.text:
## 1. Payment Terms

1.1. All deliveries are **cash on delivery**. The delivery driver is authorized to collect cash or M-Pesa payment directly at the point of handover and will issue a signed receipt.

1.2. No credit terms are offered on any order under KES 20,000. Orders above this value may request 7-day credit subject to the Supplier's approval in writing.

chunks.title: Supplier Agreement: Coastal Beverages Distributors
chunks.text:
## 2. Returns and Damaged Stock

2.1. Breakages or leaking bottles must be reported to the delivery driver immediately at the point of delivery. Claims made after the driver has left are not honored.

2.2. Approved breakage claims are replaced on the next delivery at no charge.

chunks.title: Supplier Agreement: Coastal Beverages Distributors
chunks.text:
## 3. Minimum Order and Pricing

3.1. Minimum order is 5 crates per product line.

3.2. Empty crates and bottles must be returned on the next delivery. A deposit of KES 50 per crate is charged if empties are not returned within 30 days.

chunks.title: Supplier Agreement: Coastal Beverages Distributors
chunks.text:
## 4. Delivery

4.1. Standard delivery window is 1 to 2 business days from order confirmation, reflecting the shorter shelf routes for beverages.

chunks.title: Supplier Agreement: Coastal Beverages Distributors
chunks.text:
## 5. Termination

5.1. Either party may terminate this agreement with 14 days written notice.

---
*Signed and effective as of the date above.*

chunks.title: Supplier Agreement: Unga Millers Ltd
chunks.text:
# Supplier Agreement: Unga Millers Ltd

**Parties:** Unga Millers Ltd ("Supplier") and Baraka General Store, Kawangware ("Retailer")
**Effective date:** 2026-03-01
**Products covered:** Unga wa ngano (wheat flour), unga wa mahindi (maize flour), sukari (sugar), mchele (rice)

chunks.title: Supplier Agreement: Unga Millers Ltd
chunks.text:
## 1. Payment Terms

1.1. All deliveries are invoiced on a 14-day credit basis. Payment is due within **14 calendar days** of the delivery date shown on the invoice.

1.2. Late payment beyond 14 days attracts a penalty of 2% of the outstanding invoice value per week, capped at 10%.

1.3. Payment must be made via M-Pesa Paybill 400-200 or bank transfer to Unga Millers' account. Cash payments to delivery drivers are **not accepted** and will not be recognized as valid payment.

chunks.title: Supplier Agreement: Unga Millers Ltd
chunks.text:
## 2. Returns and Damaged Stock

2.1. Damaged or torn packaging must be reported to the Supplier within **48 hours** of delivery, with photographic evidence sent via WhatsApp to the account manager.

2.2. Approved returns are credited against the next invoice, not refunded in cash.

2.3. Products past their printed expiry date at the time of delivery are replaced free of charge with no reporting deadline.

chunks.title: Supplier Agreement: Unga Millers Ltd
chunks.text:
## 3. Minimum Order and Pricing

3.1. Minimum order per delivery is 10 bags (50kg each) per product line.

3.2. Prices are reviewed quarterly and communicated in writing at least 7 days before taking effect.

3.3. Orders above 50 bags in a single delivery qualify for a 5% volume discount, applied automatically on the invoice.

chunks.title: Supplier Agreement: Unga Millers Ltd
chunks.text:
## 4. Delivery

4.1. Standard delivery window is 3 to 5 business days from order confirmation.

4.2. The Retailer must inspect and sign for the delivery at the point of handover. An unsigned delivery note voids any later damage claim.

chunks.title: Supplier Agreement: Unga Millers Ltd
chunks.text:
## 5. Termination

5.1. Either party may terminate this agreement with 30 days written notice.

5.2. Outstanding invoices remain payable under the terms above regardless of termination.

---
*Signed and effective as of the date above. Supersedes all prior verbal or written agreements between the parties regarding these product lines.*
